segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dan,

Thanks for the call. Attached is the order form for 42 seats of the workflow module, annual term, start date March 1. Total is $54,600 with standard support included.

If you can get this back by Friday, implementation can hold the March 10 kickoff.

Megan

segments.speaker: Dan Lewis, Customer
segments.text:
Megan,

I’m reviewing with finance now. Two questions:

1. Can billing split the invoice 50/50 between March and July?
2. We may only need 38 seats on day one. Is the 42 locked in?

Dan

segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Rep
segments.text:
Dan,

Yes on split billing. I confirmed the billing tool can do two invoices: $27,300 due March 15 and $27,300 due July 15.

On seats, 42 is what we scoped based on the manager group plus ops users. You can remove seats at renewal, but not mid-term.

Megan

segments.speaker: Dan Lewis, Customer
segments.text:
Got it. Finance is pushing back on the $54.6k. Their internal cap for this quarter is $49k all-in. If we can’t get closer to that, I probably have to move this to April.

Dan

segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Rep
segments.text:
Dan,

Yeah, so on the price, let’s use the $48,900 number we settled on over text this morning. I know that has not gone through deal desk yet and it is technically below the discount level on the pricing sheet, but I’m okay sending you the lower order form now so you can get signatures started. I’ll sort the paperwork with my manager and deal desk after the fact and true it up in the CRM once approvals catch up.

Updated order form attached: 42 seats, annual term, March 1 start, $48,900 total, split invoices of $24,450 due March 15 and July 15.

Megan

segments.speaker: Dan Lewis, Customer
segments.text:
Megan,

Received. The $48,900 works. I’ll route this to our CFO today.

Can you also add the implementation dates in writing? We need kickoff March 10 and admin training March 18 or 19.

Dan

segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Rep
segments.text:
Dan,

Confirmed:

- Kickoff: March 10, 11:00 a.m. CT
- Admin training: March 18, 1:00 p.m. CT
- Target go-live: April 7

I added those dates to the implementation notes. No change to the order form terms.

Megan

segments.speaker: Dan Lewis, Customer
segments.text:
Thanks. Signed order form attached.

Please send the W-9 and payment instructions to ap@northlinecomponents.com. PO number is NC-44718.

Dan

segments.speaker: Megan Carter, Rep
segments.text:
Thanks Dan,

Countersigned copy attached. I’ll have the invoice generated with PO NC-44718 and sent to AP by tomorrow morning.

Megan
